# Embed

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The **Embed** tab is available for Zoom SDKs. You can download Zoom SDKs to embed Zoom products in your third-party applications.

-   [Meeting SDK](/docs/meeting-sdk/) - Embed Meeting SDK and bring Zoom features to your app.
-   [Contact Center SDK](/docs/contact-center/) - Embed Contact Center SDK and bring Contact Center features to your app.

Toggle a switch to access and download the SDK packages.
